'''2008 Worlds Day 1 Brandon Brist LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brandon Brist]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 1). Sheet title Quiet Mining colony. Incomplete shield block as written.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brandon Brist]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
